desktop.notesZh: 合并上游 master（dsh 0.2.1-rc.3，提交 22ddee3792）到 baf 分支，baf 全部新特性保留：① 18 处冲突按「双方新增取并集、上游删除的旧 API 按新架构重基」解决（依赖并集、侧栏与设置页 UI 并集、上游已删 API 不复活）；② baf「多模型路由 auto」重基到上游新模型选择架构——上游把模型所有权移出 session-controller、把模型选择投影挪进 core/agent，baf 改为经新增的通用结构化扩展点 stepRouteResolver（packages/core/agent-loop/src/route-resolver.ts）在 agent loop 每步读取路由处接入，auto 伪模型按 Commander/Reviewer/Worker 档位解析，不可解析时回退会话上次请求路由→部署默认，伪模型绝不进入 provider；③ 修复合并引入的回归——上游 v0.2.1-rc.1 已撤掉独立的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents 导出（list_agents 改由主插件注册），baf 的 preset/patch 仍写该行会让会话创建失败（桌面端表现为设置面板被自动关闭、多模型路由分区打不开），已按上游升级指南删除该行，并新增体检脚本 check-baf-plugin-rows.mjs 把同类问题一次扫干净；④ 上游新增的 ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt 六种语言全部继承，baf 旧键补齐翻译；⑤ typecheck 5 关、build 10 关全绿，web 端真机走查与桌面 exe 展开目录打包、启动校验均通过。
desktop.notesEn: Merge upstream master (dsh 0.2.1-rc.3, 22ddee3792) into the baf branch with every baf feature preserved: (1) 18 conflicts resolved by unioning both sides and rebasing the upstream-deleted legacy APIs onto the new architecture instead of reviving them. (2) baf's multi-model 'auto' routing rebased onto the new model-selection architecture — upstream moved model ownership out of session-controller and the selection projection into core/agent, so baf now plugs in through the new generic structured extension point stepRouteResolver (packages/core/agent-loop/src/route-resolver.ts) at the agent loop's per-step route read: the auto pseudo-model resolves into the Commander/Reviewer/Worker tiers, falls back to the session's last request route and then to the deployment default when it cannot be resolved, and never reaches a provider. (3) Fixed a merge-introduced regression — upstream v0.2.1-rc.1 retired the standalone @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents export (list_agents is now registered by the main plugin), yet baf's preset/patch still declared that row, which broke session creation (on the desktop it surfaced as the settings panel closing by itself and the multi-model routing section never opening); the row was removed per the upstream upgrade guide and a new check-baf-plugin-rows.mjs health check now sweeps the whole class. (4) Upstream's new ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt locales are inherited with baf's existing keys translated into all six. (5) typecheck (5 gates) and build (10 gates) green; the web walkthrough and the desktop unpacked-dir packaging plus launch verification passed.
